name: Central air conditioner or heat pump (outdoor unit)

comps.spec: Contactor with a 24V AC coil and 30–40A contacts — switches pumps and heaters; derate it heavily for DC
comps.loc: Control box behind the side panel

comps.spec: Dual run capacitor, roughly 30–60 + 5 µF at 370–440V — can bite; short its terminals with an insulated screwdriver first
Condenser fan motor, 1/6–1/3 hp, 240V, about 800–1,100 RPM
Scroll or piston compressor, 1.5–5 tons — have the refrigerant recovered first
Copper refrigerant lines and coil with aluminium fins — often already stripped for scrap
comps.loc: Around the cabinet; lines run to the house

comps.spec: Outdoor disconnect box: pull-out block or fused switch, 30–60A
comps.loc: On the wall beside the unit

comps.spec: Reversing valve with a 24V coil (heat pumps)
comps.loc: Brazed into the lines near the compressor

comps.spec: Galvanised steel cabinet panels, louvres and fan grille
